general_information.Syllabus Name: Background design_Thiết kế phông nền hoạt hình
general_information.Description: This course focuses on the standards for TV and features. Students will first study backgrounds and will gain the technical knowledge needed to create them. Students will then make thumb- nail paintings and continue on to finished paintings, including large pan scenes.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook and references in advance - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment. - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Ps, Ai, Ae, Pr - Have papers, Pencils, scissors... - Complete course's Portfolio with full contents of exercises and submit to the teacher 1 day after the course
general_information.Tools: 1. School preparation: a) For each student - 01 light table b) To the studio: - Glass table - 01 projector 2. Students preparation: - Pencil, eraser, ruler, A3 paper. A4 - Computer with some version of photograph editing software such as Ps, Ai, Ae, Pr

description: This course focuses on the standards for TV and features. Students will first study backgrounds and will gain the technical knowledge needed to create them. Students will then make thumb- nail paintings and continue on to finished paintings, including large pan scenes.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Students understand the role of backgrounds, the process of building the background in 2D animation.
Understand the foreground and background in a scene.
Know the camera movements to separate objects from backgrounds.
Analyzes the storyboard to find out the number of backgrounds needed for each movie.
Splitting layers of each scene and arranging them from back to front.
Choosing right colors for each layer according to the content.
Setup camera movements and position the layers based on the storyboard.

assessments.Grading Guide: - Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, preparation, and quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussion, and builds upon others’ comments. - Teacher give marks on student's student's Class participation and preparation only after the Portfolio submission.
1. Having separate layers in a scene: 5 points 2. Drawing skill: 5 points
